item.description:

It’s Gulf of America in Google Maps only in the US, not if you’re in another country. Google is helping Trump foster his domestic delusion. Interestingly, Apple maps still labels it Gilf of México, at least for now.

Pro tip: do not search for GILF of Mexico on a work computer.
